title: Former Contacte Vivana Itakon
title_ja: 元コンタクティー、ヴィヴァナ・イタコン
summary: The document discusses several individuals, including Adolfo SAN FELAYO, Ramon USATEGUI Lazara, Herbert L. Barker, and Manolo VEGA Abril, assessing their value as potential agents or contacts for the CIA. It also mentions their backgrounds, skills, and loyalty.
